description.zh: 应用版本，1：基础版，2：专业版。
description.en: The application version. 1: Basic version, 2: Professional version.

description.zh: 应用ID，在控制台的**应用管理**页面中获取。
description.en: The ID of the application. You can obtain the application ID on the **Application Management** page in the SchedulerX console.

description.zh: 最大同时运行实例数量，默认值为1，即上次触发没有运行结束，即使到了运行时刻也不会进行下次触发。
description.en: The maximum number of concurrent instances. Default value: 1. A value of 1 specifies that if the last triggered instance is running, the next instance is not triggered even if the scheduled point in time for running the next instance is reached.

description.zh:
报警通知的配置，支持以下属性：sendChannel、alarmType 和 webhookIsAtAll。
> 此字段的详细说明参见下文**关于请求参数的补充说明**。
description.en: The configuration of the alert. The value is a JSON string. For more information about this parameter, see **Additional information about request parameters**.

description.zh:
报警联系人配置。支持配置报警联系人以及报警联系人组
> 此字段的详细说明参见下文**关于请求参数的补充说明**。
description.en: The configuration of alert contacts. The value is a JSON string.

description.zh: 命名空间ID，在控制台的**命名空间**页面中获取。
description.en: The ID of the namespace. You can obtain the ID of the namespace on the Namespace page in the SchedulerX console.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun schedulerx2 update-app-group --description Test --group-id testSchedulerx.defaultGroup --max-concurrency 1 --namespace adcfc35d-e2fe-4fe9-bbaa-20e90ffc0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --app-version 2 --monitor-config-json sendChannel_:_ding,sms,mail,phone_,_alarmType_:_Contacts_,_webhookIsAtAll_:_false --monitor-contacts-json name_:_Alice_Johnson_,_name_:_Lee_Smith --notification-policy-name test-workday-notification --enable-log true --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun schedulerx2 UpdateAppGroup --region cn-hangzhou --AppVersion 2 --Description Test --MonitorConfigJson 'sendChannel_:_ding,sms,mail,phone_,_alarmType_:_Contacts_,_webhookIsAtAll_:_false' --MaxConcurrency 1 --MonitorContactsJson 'name_:_Alice_Johnson_,_name_:_Lee_Smith' --EnableLog true --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --NotificationPolicyName 'test-workday-notification' --Namespace 'adcfc35d-e2fe-4fe9-bbaa-20e90ffc0000' --GroupId 'testSchedulerx.defaultGroup'
